Jordan: Morning team — quick async kickoff. What I did: pushed Astera pricing into CRM and jumped on LoomCare pilot checklist. Blockers: NovaCorp asking about HSM + BYOK wording and a KMS cert copy. Pipeline notes: Astera PO in legal, Tradewind demo scheduled. Today: sync w/ legal 2pm, follow up on KMS with eng-sec.

Priya: Got it. For NovaCorp the key asks are: 1) Can we support HSM-backed key wrapping? 2) Do we have a standard KMS integration diagram for customers? I opened SEC ticket SEC-4521.

Sam: Astera legal asked for DPA + SOC2 Type II. I dropped links in the deal doc but need security confirmation on what we can share (redacted vs full). Also Tradewind wants a latency SLO call, scheduled Thurs.

Avery: On Tradewind demo prep — build is ✅. No blockers. For LoomCare dedicated pilot I can produce the network peering snippet and a tfvars example. Will post shortly.

Kamal: Ack on SEC-4521. Quick answers: we support BYOK with HSM-based wrapping for Private deployments; for Hosted we offer customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (see product note). I'll upload the specific certs + expected phrasing tonight. For SOC2 sharing — we provide redacted reports to prospects; legal/security will sign off.

Priya: @Kamal can you confirm whether we need an additional LOA for on-prem HSM access? NovaCorp asked specifically about auditability.

Kamal: LOA not required in most cases, but for air-gapped HSM installs we request a connectivity and audit scoping doc. I'll attach a checklist to SEC-4521.

Avery: Pasted LoomCare tf snippet:```hcl
module "peering" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/infra-modules.git//vpc-peering"
  env    = "prod"
  cidr   = "10.8.0.0/16"
}
``` Put this in the LoomCare deal doc.

Jordan: Thanks — that's helpful. I'll drop an update to Astera legal after my 2pm call. Priya, can you confirm customer call timing for NovaCorp so we can loop in Kamal and Avery?

Priya: Tentative call tomorrow 11am PT. I'll confirm in calendar in 10m.

Sam: Quick ask — can someone from eng review the KMS section in the customer-facing SOW? @Maya or @Kamal?

Maya: Happy to review after standup. Will scan the SOW and ping edits.

security-bot: SEC-4521 -> status updated: waiting_on_security_response. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4521

Jordan: Perfect. Today plan recap: Jordan — legal sync + Astera follow-up; Priya — confirm NovaCorp call + update SEC ticket; Sam — prepare SOC2 sharing q's for legal; Avery — finalize LoomCare peering snippet and Tradewind demo assets; Kamal/Maya — security review + wording for HSM/KMS. If anyone needs me on the customer call, ping here. :thumbsup:
